svg.title: System map of an LLM application with Pavan Reddy Mogili's projects on each layer. Data and features: chronofeature, eventflow, incremental-lakehouse, query-forge. Serving: servegate, model-ledger, quorum-lab. Retrieval: temporal-rag, hard-negative-retrieval. Model and decoding: speculative-decoding, constrained-generation, model-router, pixel-to-program. Guardrails: capability-guard. Tools and runtime: resilient-agent-runtime, agent-arena. Evaluation and monitoring: agent-regression, tool-calling-lab, drift-sentinel.
